headline: Guest Relations Officer
summary: Resort restaurant server of three years now working in guest relations at the same resort in Negros Oriental. Serving guests every day taught me to read their moods and anticipate what they need; I now welcome arriving guests, handle the front desk during peak hours and help them plan their stay.
skills: Tourism assistance: tours, dive trips, transport

experience.title: Guest Relations Officer
bullets: Welcome arriving guests, explain the resort's facilities and help them settle in.
Cover the front desk during peak hours and weekend check-ins.
Arrange island-hopping, dive trips and transport with local operators.

experience.title: Restaurant Server
bullets: Served breakfast buffets and à la carte dinners for up to 150 guests.
Followed food safety and hygiene rules in the dining room and pantry.
Remembered regular guests' preferences, earning frequent mentions in guest reviews.

education.credential: Food and Beverage Services NC II
